findings.rule: A file naming another org than `ORG`, an unknown kind or store, a store entry without `store`, or two entries with one name stops the run with the offending values.
findings.input:
org: o
approvers: [human]
repos:
  - {name: app, kind: code, store: ledger, purpose: p}
findings.finding: The unknown store value `ledger` is checked only on `kind: store` entries, so on a code, docs or plain entry it is silently ignored and the run proceeds instead of stopping with the offending value.

findings.rule: A file naming another org than `ORG`, an unknown kind or store, a store entry without `store`, or two entries with one name stops the run with the offending values.
findings.finding: The duplicate check compares names case-sensitively, so two entries that name the same GitHub repo (`App` and `app`, which the forge treats as one name) pass validation and the run goes on instead of stopping.

findings.rule: Without `--plan` the command behaves as today.
findings.input: pandoscope org init o --meta META --project app   (no --description, no --approver, no --plan)
findings.finding: Without `--plan`, a missing `--description` or `--approver` no longer gets argparse's usage error with exit 2 as today; `main` lets the ValueError from `_plan` escape as an uncaught traceback, a change the PR body names but the ticket rules out.
